content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the use of a timer (msg_timer) in the message timeout function, which executes in bottom-half (BH) context. Since the socket lock may be acquired in that context, it leads to potential deadlocks or race conditions when other parts of the code attempt to acquire the same lock. To resolve this, the patch replaces the timer with delayed work (msg_timer_work), which allows the timeout to be handled in a safer context without locking issues.
